# TonConnectPendingDisconnectHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.TonConnectPendingDisconnectHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The TonConnectPendingDisconnect handler class. Used to handle TON Connect sessions that must be
disconnected. It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_ton_connect_pending_disconnect`](../decorators/on_ton_connect_pending_disconnect.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when TON Connect sessions must be disconnected. It takes
  *(client, ton_connect_pending_disconnect)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for
  a detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    ton_connect_pending_disconnect ([`TonConnectPendingDisconnect`](../types/wallet/TonConnectPendingDisconnect.md)):
        The sessions to disconnect with disconnect_ton_connect_session.

_Source: `pyrogram/handlers/ton_connect_pending_disconnect_handler.py`._
